name: Poseidra, the Atlantean Dragon
extDescription: You can Tribute 3 Level 3 or lower WATER monsters; Special Summon this card from your hand or Graveyard. When you do: Return all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the hand, and if you do, if 3 or more cards are returned to the hand by this effect, all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 300 ATK for each.

name: Atlantean Dragoons
extDescription: All Level 3 or lower Sea Serpent-Type monsters you control can attack your opponent directly. When this card is sent to the Graveyard for the activation of a WATER monster's effect: Add 1 Sea Serpent-Type monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Atlantean Dragoons".

name: Atlantean Marksman
extDescription: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent-Type "Atlantean" monster, except "Atlantean Marksman", from your Deck. When this card is sent to the Graveyard for the activation of a WATER monster's effect: Target 1 Set card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Atlantean Heavy Infantry
extDescription: While this card is face-up on the field, once per turn during your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon a Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent-Type monster in addition to your Normal Summon or Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) When this card is sent to the Graveyard for the activation of a WATER monster's effect: Target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Atlantean Pikeman
extDescription: The Great Ocean Lord, who reigns over the depths, is served by these lancers. Deep-sea creatures exist in fear of facing the stream of attacks their lances are capable of.

name: Atlantean Attack Squad
extDescription: This card gains 800 ATK while you control a face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster other than this card.

name: Lost Blue Breaker
extDescription: If there is another face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster on the field: You can Tribute this card to target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Armed Sea Hunter
extDescription: If you control another face-up WATER monster, negate the effects of the monster that battled with this card, after damage calculation. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy 1 face-up Level 3 or lower WATER monster you control instead.

name: Spined Gillman
extDescription: All Fish-Type, Sea Serpent-Type, and Aqua-Type monsters you control gain 400 ATK.

name: Deep Sea Diva
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Sea Serpent-Type monster from your Deck.

name: Mermaid Archer
extDescription: Once per turn, you can equip 1 Level 3 or lower monster you control to this card. If you do, this card gains 800 ATK. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy the equipped monster instead. (You can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card.)

name: Codarus
extDescription: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the Graveyard to select up to 2 cards your opponent controls and send them to the Graveyard.

name: Warrior of Atlantis
extDescription: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 "A Legendary Ocean" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Abyss Soldier
extDescription: Once per turn: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard to target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand.

name: Skreech
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle, select 2 WATER monsters from your Deck and send them to your Graveyard.

name: Snowman Eater
extDescription: When this card is flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Nightmare Penguin
extDescription: When this card is flipped face-up, select 1 card your opponent controls, and return it to the hand. All face-up WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK.

name: Penguin Soldier
extDescription: FLIP: You can target up to 2 monsters on the field; return those targets to the hand.

name: Deep Diver
extDescription: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Choose 1 Monster Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck.

name: Reese the Ice Mistress
extDescription: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 4 or higher monster.

name: Mother Grizzly
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

name: Friller Rabca
extDescription: When a face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and that target loses 500 ATK until your next End Phase. The effect of "Friller Rabca" can only be activated once per turn.

name: Call of the Atlanteans
extDescription: Target 3 Level 3 or lower Sea Serpent-Type monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon all 3 of them. You cannot Special Summon other monster(s) during the turn you activate this card.

name: A Legendary Ocean
extDescription: This card's name is treated as "Umi". Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both player's hands and on the field by 1. All WATER monsters gain 200 ATK and DEF.

name: Terraforming
extDescription: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Water Hazard
extDescription: Once per turn, if you control no monsters, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster from your hand.

name: Aqua Jet
extDescription: Target 1 face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK.

name: Surface
extDescription: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position.

name: Moray of Greed
extDescription: Shuffle 2 WATER monsters from your hand into your Deck and draw 3 cards.

name: Salvage
extDescription: Select 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard, and add them to your hand.

name: Dark Hole
extDescription: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Big Wave Small Wave
extDescription: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters on your side of the field. Then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the same number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

name: Aegis of the Ocean Dragon Lord
cleanName: Aegis of the Ocean Dragon Lord
extDescription: Until the End Phase of this turn, all face-up Level 3 or lower WATER monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

name: Forgotten Temple of the Deep
extDescription: While this card is on the field, this card's name is treated as "Umi". Once per turn, you can select and remove from play 1 face-up Level 4 or lower Fish-Type, Sea Serpent-Type or Aqua-Type monster you control. (This effect can be activated during either player's turn.) Special Summon it during your End Phase.

name: Tornado Wall
extDescription: Activate only while "Umi" is on the field. As long as "Umi" remains face-up on the field, you take no damage from attacking monsters. When "Umi" is removed from the field, destroy this card.

name: Torrential Tribute
extDescription: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Spiritual Water Art - Aoi
extDescription: Tribute 1 WATER monster on your side of the field. Look at your opponent's hand, select 1 card from it, and send that card to the Graveyard.

name: Gravity Bind
extDescription: Level 4 or higher monsters cannot attack.

name: Poseidon Wave
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate that target's attack, and if you control any face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monsters, inflict 800 damage to your opponent for each of those monsters.

name: Realm of the Sea Dragon Structure Deck [1st Edition]
cleanName: Realm of the Sea Dragon Structure Deck 1st Edition
extDescription:
Atlantis! The legendary undersea kingdom is about to rise again. And this time, YOU will lead it, to reclaim its ancient glory! As the new Sea Emperor, all the forces of the Atlantean army are yours to command: infantry, archers, cavalry, and the mighty Sea Dragon called Poseidra! Remember – whoever rules the seas, rules the world!
The armies of Atlantis are so vast that many other strategies and tactics are waiting to be mastered. So be sure you don’t get stranded when the tide rolls out, because the throne of Atlantis is waiting for you!
Each Realm of the Sea Emperor Structure Deck contains:
1 Preconstructed Deck of 40 cards (1 Ultra Rare, 2 Super Rares, 37 Commons)
1 Rulebook
1 Dueling Guide
1 Playmat
